sections.title: 1. Who is responsible for your data

blocks.p: Catarinotlón, located at Tecámac, State of Mexico, organizes the Catarinotlón 2026 and is responsible for processing your personal data. For any privacy matter write to contact@catarinotlon.online.

ul: Identification and contact: full name, email, and phone.
Account: your password (stored encrypted, never in readable text) or the identifier Google shares with us if you sign in with your Google account.
Registration: distance, shirt size, and the name you choose for your shirt.
Payment: the receipt of your SPEI bank transfer. That document may show the account holder's name, the bank, part of your account number, the amount, and the date.
Site usage: your chosen language and theme, technical error logs, and browsing statistics (pages visited, clicks, and recordings of your visit, in which we hide what you type and your personal data).

blocks.p: We do not ask for sensitive personal data. The payment receipt contains financial data: by uploading it you give us your express consent to use it for the purposes of this notice.
Purposes necessary to provide the service:

ul: Create and protect your account.
Record your registration and validate your payment.
Personalize your shirt and prepare your kit.
Issue your ticket and give you your kit and medal.
Send you notices about your registration and the event.
Answer your questions and meet legal obligations.

blocks.p: Additional purposes, which you can refuse at any time by writing to contact@catarinotlon.online: telling you about future editions of the Catarinotlón and measuring how the site is used to improve it.
We do not sell your data. We only share it with those who help us run the event, under our instructions:

ul: Website hosting, database, and file storage providers.
Email delivery provider.
Error monitoring provider.
Browsing statistics and visit recording provider.
Google, only if you choose to sign in with your Google account.
The shirt printer, which receives your shirt name and size.

blocks.p: Some of these providers process information outside Mexico.

We keep your account and registration data for as long as your account exists. Payment receipts are kept with no defined deletion period, as a record of payments received. If you ask for your data to be canceled (section 6), we irreversibly replace your personal data with anonymous data.

You can access, rectify, cancel, or object to the use of your data (ARCO rights), and revoke your consent or limit its use or disclosure. Send your request to contact@catarinotlon.online with your name, your account email, and what you are requesting.
If you believe we did not address your request, you can go to the personal data protection authority.

We use the cookies needed to keep you signed in and remember your language and theme, and an anonymous identifier for browsing statistics. We do not use advertising cookies. If you turn on your browser’s “Do Not Track” option, we collect no browsing statistics.
If this notice changes, we will publish the new version on this page and, if the change is important, we will let you know by email.
By creating an account or registering for the Catarinotlón 2026 you accept these terms and our Privacy notice. The event is organized by Catarinotlón.
The Catarinotlón 2026 is a race with 3K and 5K distances. It will take place on {eventDate} at {venue}. Schedules, the route, and kit pickup are published on this site.

ul: The data you enter must be true and up to date.
Your account is personal. Protect your password and tell us if someone else accessed your account.
One account can register several people. Each registration is for a single runner, with their own shirt, number, and ticket.
The registration fee is the same for 3K and 5K: {fee}.
The only payment method is a SPEI bank transfer to the account shown in your account, for the exact amount and with the stated concept. One transfer can cover several runners on your account.
After transferring you must upload your receipt.
Your registration is confirmed when we validate your payment. Your ticket is issued at that moment.
If we can't validate your receipt we will tell you why and you can upload a new one.
You can change your distance whenever you want, even after paying. Since the fee is the same, the change is free.
You can change your shirt name whenever you want.
You can change your shirt size only until {sizeDeadline}.

blocks.p: There are no cancellations or refunds. Once we validate your payment, the registration fee is not returned, even if you decide not to take part or cannot attend.

ul: Your registration includes a shirt personalized with the name you choose and a finisher medal you receive when you cross the finish line.
The kit is handed out at {kitPickup} when you show your ticket with its QR code. If you can't make it, someone else can collect it for you by showing your ticket.
Each runner has a unique five-digit bib number.

blocks.p: You take part voluntarily and at your own risk. You declare that your health allows you to complete the distance you chose.
These terms are governed by the laws of Mexico. For questions write to {contactEmail}.
